# branding/ - Aetherfox v1 icon set (versioned source)
# Generated by scripts/generate-icons.py from Downloads/thumbnail.png
# (blue molecular mark, 1254x1254 RGBA, transparent background).
#
# Contents:
#  default{16,22,24,32,48,64,128,256}.png - window/taskbar icons
#  firefox.ico, firefox64.ico, document.ico, newtab.ico, newwindow.ico,
#    pbmode.ico - multi-size ICOs (16..256)
#  content/about-logo.png (192), content/about-logo@2x.png (384)
#  content/about.png (300x236, mark over the #130829 dialog background)
# The SVGs (about-logo.svg with the embedded PNG, the "Aetherfox" wordmarks) live
# as text in patches/core/00-branding-aether.patch, not here.
#
# sync.py copies all of this over browser/branding/aether/ in the tree
# (after applying patch 00 and filling the gaps from unofficial/).
# To regenerate after changing the logo: python scripts/generate-icons.py
